title: Reward-rate Policy Gradient for Efficient Machine Learning Engineering Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) techniques focus on maximizing expected cumulative reward, where each action assumes to take a constant unit of time. However, this assumption does not hold for agentic RL tasks such as machine learning engineering (MLE) agents, where actions involve data loading, feature engineering, and model training that take variable durations. Efficiency matters in modern agentic RL where actions are costly. To address this limitation, we adapt from continuous-time RL and Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) formulation and propose Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), where we focus on optimizing the reward rate -- the long-term reward per unit of time. RPG estimates the reward rate from off-policy samples, then charges each action for the time it consumes at that rate. translated_title: 面向高效机器学习工程智能体的奖励率策略梯度
translated_abstract: 传统强化学习（RL）技术专注于最大化期望累积奖励，其中假设每个动作都花费恒定的单位时间。然而，这一假设对于机器学习工程（MLE）智能体等智能体强化学习任务并不成立，因为这些任务中的动作涉及数据加载、特征工程和模型训练，其持续时间各不相同。在现代智能体强化学习中，由于动作代价高昂，效率至关重要。为了解决这一局限，我们借鉴连续时间强化学习和半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP）的框架，提出了奖励率策略梯度，其核心在于优化奖励率——即单位时间内的长期奖励。RPG从离策略样本中估计奖励率，然后按该比率对每个动作所消耗的时间进行“计费”。我们首先在多臂老虎机设置下进行理论分析，证明RPG能够逼近最优奖励率，并通过实验进行了验证。
tldr: 该论文提出奖励率策略梯度（RPG），通过优化单位时间内的长期奖励而非传统的累积奖励，解决了机器学习工程智能体中动作耗时不一的问题，从而实现更高效的智能体强化学习训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), which optimizes the long-term reward per unit of time instead of traditional cumulative reward, addressing the variable action durations in machine learning engineering agents to enable more efficient agentic reinforcement learning.
